handbookNote: Arizona Driver License Manual and Customer Service Guide (rev. March 2026), Arizona Department of Transportation Motor Vehicle Division. Official PDF fetched directly from apps.azdot.gov/files/mvd/mvd-forms-lib/99-0117.pdf (linked from azdot.gov/resources/arizona-driver-license-manual and azdot.gov/motor-vehicles/driver-services/tests-manuals-and-driving-schools/manuals). Full 74-page text extracted to temp/handbooks/az/driver.txt and used as the sole factual source for every question. Exam mechanics -- CONFIRMED: passing score is 80% or higher, per azdot.gov's official Practice Tests page (azdot.gov/motor-vehicles/driver-services/tests-manuals-and-driving-schools/practice-tests), which states 'A score of 80% or higher is required to pass the actual examination.' Exam mechanics -- NOT CONFIRMED: the real knowledge test's exact item count and whether it is timed are not stated on the manual, the MVD FAQ, or the MVD Fast Facts page. The one official page most likely to contain this (azdot.gov/written-and-verbal-tests, linked from the Practice Tests page as 'More information on the examination') returned a persistent HTTP 403 Access Denied directly from ADOT's own Drupal CMS across repeated attempts with varied headers and via multiple retrieval paths, so it could not be read. The three official online practice tests (test1.aspx, test2.aspx, test3.aspx at apps.azdot.gov/mvd/PracticeTest/) contain 35, 30, and 30 questions respectively, which is suggestive of the real exam length but is NOT asserted here as confirmed, per the project's no-default-values rule -- no item count or time limit is stated anywhere in this bank or its supporting materials. Content-depth rationale: the manual is unusually dense for a state driver handbook (74 pages of substantive rules, not summary text) covering licensing and Graduated Driver License rules, required vehicle equipment, seatbelt and child-restraint law, insurance minimums, traffic signals and sign shapes, pavement markings and lane use, right-of-way and roundabouts, speed limits and following distance, parking rules, freeway and HOV driving, sharing the road with bicycles/motorcycles/trucks/school buses/light rail, distracted driving and wireless-device law, DUI and alcohol/drug law (including exact BAC thresholds, jail/fine minimums, and the points table), weather and mechanical emergency procedures, crash-reporting procedures, license suspension/revocation grounds, and law-enforcement stop procedures. This supported 270 distinct, non-repetitive, page-cited questions after genuine research; the bank was built to this honest ceiling rather than padded to hit a round number. Every question is grounded in a specific statement in the fetched manual text, with a page-and-section citation in its source_note.
